Use case: illustration-story. Make exactly THREE equal-width full-height TALL portrait Mars game backgrounds side by side, each 390:844, as one high resolution landscape source atlas. Straight vertical divisions, no labels, gutters, borders, lettering, people or UI. Input1 supplies exact warm Martian terrain and blue-white layered ice treatment; input2 equipment reference supplies cream painted metal, mustard mobility accents and realistic restrained retro-industrial finish. Every panel leaves lower 62% broad QUIET unobstructed reddish earth for dragging icons; narrative scenery and fixed targets in upper 38%, key targets wholly within center 82% width. Soft coherent natural daylight, realistic tangible materials, slight dust and wear, not cartoon/vector. These are three moments along ONE short route from station across shallow wash to exposed ice.
LEFT PANEL: Rover loading area near the cave workshop. One complete small delivered six-wheeled cream rover with muted mustard panels parked across upper background, angled so its empty rear cargo deck faces camera at x50%,y29%. Large rugged charcoal tires, simple roll-over frame, driver seat farther back; rear deck has factory power socket and ordinary tie-down eyes. Cargo mount must be visually CLEAR and EMPTY for the player to install a made refrigerated case. No refrigerator, core, winch line, spare parts or duplicate rover. Low rocky cave hill and tiny cream habitat are distant, not dominant. Broad empty ochre foreground.
MIDDLE PANEL: Shallow dry wash. At x32%,y27% a SHORT soft pale dusty sand strip crosses an otherwise firm rocky vehicle route; show slightly sunken sand and firm supported approaches close either side, a shallow wash NOT a gorge. At x72%,y25% a broad solid dark-rust rounded rock outcrop stands on firm ground for an anchor sling. Far route continues toward a low ice bank. No bridge, traction panels, rope, winch, vehicle or tracks already across; player makes crossing. All ground remains visibly supported, no cliff abyss. Lower 62% empty quiet ground.
RIGHT PANEL: remote low stable ice bank. A clear blue-white ice cap overlays one natural continuous BROWN band, with clear ice below too. Exposed bank only waist-height to a person, a gently backed slope rather than unsupported overhang. Central accessible brown layer at x50%,y27%, broad enough for clean coring. Fine stratification visibly continues into the bank; reddish rocks around edges. No fossils or giant creature outlined in ice, no sample core, corer, field case, survey marker text, liquid water or rover. The difference from water-source ice is the conspicuous intact brown layer with clear cap and protected interior. Lower 62% quiet warm soil.
No future fabrication or unexplained precision machines: rover imported, geological features natural.
